caption:
🧠 DID YOU KNOW? 🤯

Your beloved OLED screen is fighting a hidden battle, and blue light is the secret villain!

Here's the mind-blowing reality:
🔹 Blue OLED subpixels degrade 3X faster than red or green, thanks to their high-energy emissions.
🔹 To compensate, phone manufacturers make blue subpixels twice as large!
🔹 This engineering trick ensures your screen ages gracefully and colors stay vibrant longer.
